rules: This file is a schema/template only. Public GitHub data must never be treated as live Robinhood account state.
Populate live values only from confirmed Robinhood balances, positions, orders and fills in the private runtime.
Unknown or contradictory live state blocks new entries.
UNPROTECTED exposure must never be treated as safe merely because a planned stop exists in Teststock.
Fractional synthetic monitoring is degraded protection and is not equivalent to a broker-resident stop.
